en.headline: Hong Kong Youth Olympics team receives its flag
en.dek: Fifteen athletes will contest 12 sports in Dakar from 31 October to 13 November, the first Olympic event hosted in Africa.
body: Hong Kong's delegation to the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games received its flag on Tuesday, ahead of the Games in Senegal from 31 October to 13 November.

Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law presented the regional flag. Sports Federation and Olympic Committee president Timothy Fok and delegation leader Mok Kwan-yat were among those at the ceremony. The team will send 15 athletes, 10 men and five women, in 12 sports, including fencing, wushu and breaking.
The Games were postponed from 2022 because of the pandemic. Dakar will be the first Olympic event hosted in Africa.
A men's foil team silver medallist at the Asian Games, fencer Ho, said he hoped to go further than a senior who had finished second and to take first place.

zh.headline: 達卡青奧會港隊代表團今日授旗
zh.dek: 港隊派15人出戰12個項目，賽事10月31日至11月13日在塞內加爾達卡舉行，為非洲首次主辦的奧林匹克賽事。
body: 達卡2026青年奧林匹克運動會中國香港代表團周二舉行授旗儀式。賽事將於10月31日至11月13日在塞內加爾達卡舉行。
文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩向代表團授予區旗。港協暨奧委會會長霍震霆及代表團團長莫君逸等人出席。港隊派出10男5女共15名運動員，出戰包括劍擊、武術及霹靂舞在內的12個項目。
今屆青奧會受疫情影響，由2022年延至今年舉行，亦是非洲首次主辦的奧林匹克賽事。
亞運男子花劍團體銀牌得主何承謙表示，希望突破師兄蔡俊彥的成績。他說蔡俊彥曾取得第二，並鼓勵他爭取第一。
